fullContentHtml:
BCECE-LE 1st Round Allotment Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) has released the 1st Round Allotment Result for the BCECE (LE) Lateral Entry In Second Year of Graduate Level Engineering Courses And Para-Medical, Pharmacy Courses. The counselling/ choice filling process for BCECE-LE 2026 started on 13 July 2026, and candidates can fill till 21 July 2026. Candidates must download their for BCECE-LE 1st Round Allotment Result 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 09 April 2026
  • Last Date : 07 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 08 May 2026
  • Online Editing-Application Form : 10-11 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 31 May 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 23 May 2026
  • Result Available : 24 June 2026
  • Counselling/ Choice Filling : 13-21 July 2026
  • 1st Round Allotment Result : 25 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, BC, EBC, EWS : Rs. 2200/-
  • SC, ST, DQ : Rs. 2200/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
